description: This file defines a wizard for tracking and splitting stock move lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form definitions, validation, and move line creation logic.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: A wizard interface class for tracking stock move lines and creating production lots.

methods.name: _check_picking
methods.description: Validates that the stock move has an associated picking before proceeding.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Splits a stock move into multiple moves with new production lots based on specified quantity and prefix.
